node.title: KoalaBear m4 outer A6/S6 route cut
node.closure: primitive degree-15 subdegree classification plus proper-factor routing
node.statement: For an inner-degree-four terminal, the outer degree-15 correspondence types are (r,delta)=(1,16),(2,8),(4,4),(8,2). The complete primitive degree-15 catalogue has no nontrivial subdegree 1,2,4; those types force a proper outer factor of degree 3 or 5 and hence impossible endpoint inner degree 12 or 20. Only (8,2) survives, with outer monodromy A6 or S6 on two-subsets. The independent transverse frontier has nine types. No survivor deletion, owner, charge, u2, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
